scope: Complete real six-domain non-DR publication. This review neither installs provider permissions nor runs a probe, SQL, signing, object write or isolated restore.
frozen_sources: Existing C taskless five-source batch remains unchanged. Its known_ordinary_blocker was historical: current A SQL signing source now permits acceptance or functional_test with the exact full six-part set, and root reports the A/D/C R2 component combination passed. No native SQL/page conclusion follows.

repository_findings.finding: Authenticates no producer, issuer or native endpoint. Checks role/identity/version/scope/time/content shape and cleanup. Supported, unsupported and degraded observations are valid; nonempty observations need not contain the complete required code set. It cannot itself authorize five provider purposes.

Closed-schema content and expected policy/expiry comparison. Its own contract says producer authentication and D transaction-time current authority remain external. Registered evidence checksum/healthy/expiry alone cannot supply that missing provenance.

Existing framework can authenticate evaluator provenance, the complete result request, original scope/run/input/profile and times, and configured projection. No concrete MinIO account/effective-policy observer or C deployment selection for five original principal-use bindings was found in current wiring. Reuse this framework once A/D install real observer/target/evidence provenance; do not replace it with a callback returning nil.

Actual task-targeted versioned object presence observer for existing manifest/marker/acceptance external actions. It reads native object metadata/full content and authenticates expected identity/action/version/hash/length. It does not observe current PUT/DELETE/catalog-append IAM permissions, and cannot be called tasklessly with a dummy external action.
Consumer validates current capability statuses/identity/time but takes inert Capability values. Actual trusted producer/source integration remains required.

Explicit transport mapping, not provider permission or readiness proof. Current publication uses versionId reads; candidate cleanup deletes an exact version and confirms NoSuchVersion, so generic bucket read/write or ordinary unversioned delete claims are insufficient.

conclusion: Repository interfaces and evidence storage are reusable, but no sufficiently authenticated, current five-purpose MinIO permission source is wired for direct C consumption. This was a source review only; it does not assert that live owner-issued materials do not exist. Root/A/D must identify any existing registered current source and its original pins/provenance before creating a new one.
reusable_after_owner_installation: CapabilityEvidence/closed CapabilityRedactor for bounded redacted observation content; require every exact required code supported/none and exact independently derived request scope for each required purpose
Original producer scope/domain/grant/run/evaluator admission, authenticated complete result/receipt, current revocation and original observation/evidence windows
Original current config references and exact artifact/catalog/CA/publication-policy bindings already read by C
Existing C dependency upper bounds, real signer factory and actual staging checks; no change to original full task verification or publication loop

minimum_missing_inputs.original_authorization: Independently enrolled original MinIO permission-owner/evaluator issuer or existing authenticated producer scope with immutable evaluator-profile pin; exact installation/config hash/provider target hash, five allowed principal-use tuples, original grant revision/epoch, not_before/until, current revocation read source and exact source/evidence/receipt IDs+hashes. A self-supplied JSON document or a privileged local credential file is not this source.
minimum_missing_inputs.observer_identity: A dedicated installed MinIO read-only observer identity, separated from all five operational credentials and held by the original observer workload. Bind actual Namespace/Pod/SA or original producer subject to the original observation grant. It performs only reviewed named metadata GETs, never creates/attaches a policy or changes a user. Raw target/admin secrets and IAM responses are never returned to C/logs.
minimum_missing_inputs.transport: Exact original HTTPS MinIO admin and S3 endpoints, independently pinned CA/TLS identity, provider/deployment or service/cluster identity, observed installed server image/version/API profile, region and exact artifact bucket/formal root/remote staging root plus independent catalog bucket/root. Never derive the trusted endpoint or CA from incoming evidence. The repo deployment image is not evidence of the running version.
minimum_missing_inputs.principal_binding: For each of artifact_read, artifact_write, artifact_delete, catalog_read, catalog_append: exact current config identity_hash/ref_version -> independently owner-bound native principal/account fingerprint and account kind; exact policy identities+content hashes and exact resources/request conditions. Do not infer internal identity_hash from AccessKey or treat one CapabilityEvidence.IdentityHash as all five distinct principals.
minimum_missing_inputs.current_read_source: Actual native account status and complete effective policy sources, including parent/group/session and bucket/resource policies when applicable; issuer/evaluator and current grant checks before and after observation. Exact named live sources are needed, not just healthy evidence metadata or a response-shape hash.
minimum_missing_inputs.source_selection: A/D must install independently pinned source selection for each of the five principal-use bindings, or a reviewed authenticated producer scope hash that explicitly commits the complete five-binding map. Existing configured-target/role canonicality must be reviewed; never overload an artifact or catalog identity with unrelated principals.
minimum_missing_inputs.expiry: Original authority not_before/until and current revocation fence; native service-account/STS/session expiration when present; original observation started/finished/expires; evidence expiry, evaluator/observer identity validity and trusted maximum observation age. Output is their intersection with current config/Forward/C dependency bounds. No now+TTL renewal, no use of local credential-file Until as provider-issued expiry.

minimal_native_profile.initial_scope: Explicit built-in non-root regular users, no groups, STS/federation, parent inheritance or unknown conditions. This is a proposed minimum supported profile, not an assertion about the installed accounts. Other kinds fail with a concrete unsupported-profile error until all their authority sources are read.
minimal_native_profile.api_profile: Version-pinned MinIO Admin v3 reference profile, subject to exact installed-version verification by root/A/D. Use named GetUserInfo/accessKey, InfoCannedPolicyV2/name and read exact bucket policy; get bucket versioning if the capability conclusion includes retained versions. If service accounts are actually required, InfoServiceAccount, parent effective policy and native expiration are additionally mandatory.
minimal_native_profile.observer_permissions: For the minimal flat-user profile: only reviewed admin:GetUser and admin:GetPolicy metadata permissions, plus s3:GetBucketPolicy and optionally s3:GetBucketVersioning on exact target buckets. Group/service-account/STS read rights are not silently granted. Admin API permissions can be broader than a target account allowlist; do not claim server-side per-account scoping merely because the client enforces names. Keep this credential inside an isolated original observer, or place a source-owner read-only broker in front.
minimal_native_profile.read_allowlist: GET /minio/admin/v3/user-info?accessKey=<original named account>; GET /minio/admin/v3/info-canned-policy?name=<original policy>&v=2; GET <exact S3 bucket>?policy; optionally GET <exact bucket>?versioning. No enumerate-all/export-IAM, PUT/POST policy management, user management, signing, object PUT or DELETE.
minimal_native_profile.evaluation: Use exact server-compatible IAM semantics: explicit deny overrides allow; evaluate full resource and request condition context for the original controller/uploader use. Reject unknown identity kind, omitted inherited/session/resource policy, unsupported condition, unknown caller/network context, missing account, disabled/revoked identity, broad/unreviewed policy and unobserved source. Never parse policy by substring or trust a supplied allowed/passed boolean.
minimal_native_profile.stability: Bind endpoint/provider identity, original owner/evaluator source and full account/policy/resource facts before and after the bounded read. A pair of equal hashes is not a globally atomic MinIO IAM snapshot or a grant valid through a future operation; task-time current checks and actual provider operations remain mandatory.

purpose_requirements.required: Versioned object GET/read over original formal artifact and original remote-staging namespaces; exact bucket/root and native account binding; version-list permission only where the actual required read path uses listing.

Actual PUT permission over exactly the original upload staging and formal publication namespaces; independent write principal. Conditional create/checksum/length/provider deadline semantics require separately authenticated actual capability observations, not inference from IAM PutObject permission.

Exact-version delete rights for original remote candidate staging namespace only, including native DeleteObjectVersion semantics; do not grant formal artifact or catalog deletion. Independent read confirms exact NoSuchVersion at task time.
Versioned object GET/read for the independent original catalog root using its own exact principal and reference.

Actual conditional PUT permission for the original independent catalog namespace. IAM PutObject allowance does not prove append-only/immutability or conditional-create support; those remain separately authenticated capability and original native-use checks.

proposed_concrete_consumer: After real sources are installed: a C concrete MinIOPublicationPermissionReader constructed only from independently pinned startup files, actual DB/workload identity and original observer authority. CheckCurrent(ctx, service) derives all expected original bindings itself, reads native named metadata or authenticated original producer receipts, validates raw source/provenance/windows, and returns a private inert observation/error. No caller-supplied pass DTO or approval callback. Only a new reviewed batch may replace the frozen five-source checker final missing-source branch.

ownership.A: Original source/evaluator identity, permission-owner grant and current revocation/authentication; preserve existing source trust and negative-acceptance verification.
ownership.D: Actual installed endpoint/API version, observer workload and read-only privileges, canonical target/config/producer/evidence source installation and original expiry mapping.
ownership.C: Concrete read/consumer, independently derived five-purpose bindings, exact supported-code and expiry/currentness validation, then D dependency call; retain complete non-DR publication checks.
